title: Leading with photography
slide_intent: Show when a strong photograph should determine the visual hierarchy. Readers need room to see the subject even when a campaign headline is present.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can vary the intensity of its graphics while retaining recognition through its headline treatments.
demonstration: A diagonal montage of communications pairs large photographs with compact colored headline strips. The note at left ties the approach to the image and message.
practical_value: Try the image at full size with a short headline before introducing additional devices. Check that its key gesture or subject stays visible.

content_islands.name: Selection principle
content_islands.spec: Use a white introductory column with the heading and guidance; place the pink reminder about image and topic lower down.

content_islands.name: Campaign montage
content_islands.spec: On the right, angle a grid of photographic layouts against black gutters. Give the pictures generous area and keep their headline strips close to each image.
